notes.title: Patch 0.3.1.4 - Changes to melting ice and minor bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b] Ice no longer completely melts every day,[/b] Now only half of the remaining ice will melt each day. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b] Fixed minor bugs [/b] including changing Satisfaction Points to round correctly. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1.0 New Localisations, and added tooltips
notes.content:
Patch 0.3.1.0 brings new localisations, which now includes almost all languages available on Steam for both in-game and for the Steam page. Welcome, new players!

Added a tool-tip for items and upgrades to provide a brief description of what the upgrades do.

Good luck and have fun on your journey to becoming the most successful Bubble Tea Tycoon!

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0.0 Update: City Expansion for Boba Bar: Bubble Tea Tycoon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744645/7970baebdb9915c0bce8514496d00f4985211f5c.gif[/img]

[b]Hey Bubble Tea Entrepreneurs,[/b]

 Say hello to skyscrapers, fast-paced crowds, and, of course, even more [i]bubble tea and cat madness[/i].

[b]Key Highlights:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b] Chic New Venue:[/b] Discover the vibrant city center, where the art is as fresh as our ingredients and the digital billboards shine almost as bright as your future.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Unlock on Day 10:[/b] Gear up to unlock the city scene after your 10th day of business. Brush up on your budgeting—city life is pricey but profitable!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Upgrade Your Customer Base:[/b] With high rents come high rollers. Attract a wealthier clientele eager to spend more on your gourmet bubble tea.
[/list]

Prepare to dive into the vibrant city atmosphere, where every challenge is just another flavor in the great bubble tea blend of life. I hope you relish this bustling new setting as you continue to shake, stir, and expand your bubble tea empire.

[url=https://ko-fi.com/kwaussiestudios]I have also launched a Ko-fi page for anyone interested in giving some extra support![/url]

Check out the brand new landing page for Kwaussie Studios! https://www.kwaussiestudios.com.au/

notes.content:
There were a couple of bugs that have been addressed, and are now working as intended.

[list]

[/list]
[list]
[*]Updated weather system to correctly persist through sessions and menu changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.2 - New UI features, new upgrades available, and, a Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays Everyone!

I hope you're all enjoying the holiday period. To celebrate, I've planned a Kickstarter campaign which I'm getting ready to launch just after New Years Day!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kwaussiestudios/boba-bar-bubble-tea-tycoon]Check it out here and enable notifications now![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744645/8d6f9c4bf40c1c3ac747752066637147feba7d93.png[/img]



[b]Patch 0.1.2 has just released with some much anticipated UI and functionality updates alongside a few new items to try out![/b]

[u][b]What's new[/b][/u] -
[list]
[*] Customers now display an ingredient icon of what they're unsatisfied with - It's still up you you to figure out if they want less or more!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744645/825933d3279ae54f08909cce27c8b1ed8b892dd5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744645/825933d3279ae54f08909cce27c8b1ed8b892dd5.gif[/img][/url]
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can now click through the tutorials as well as press 'Enter'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744645/fb01f87132ed9251814efba75ad793851858cc70.png[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[*] A new Drink is available to be unlocked, alongside the Cash Register which once unlocked, will be available to rent (it's worth it!) also, a cool new animation when a special drink is purchased!
Check these items out in the Unlock section in the Main Menu.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744645/66a1e40943849d8ea4a8c2a9f16ca4158e99370f.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744645/66a1e40943849d8ea4a8c2a9f16ca4158e99370f.gif[/img][/url]
[/list]
[list]
[*] The Demo now runs for [b]40 days[/b] instead of 7 before it is reset.
[/list]
